title: fix: bill Grok videos that xAI rejects after generating them
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
## What changes

- Charges `grok-imagine-video` requests that xAI rejects **after** generating the video. fal bills us for these; we charged the user nothing.
- Requests rejected before generation stay free.
- The error message tells the caller the request was charged.

| Rejection | fal bills us | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| After generation (fal echoes the whole request) | yes | free | video price |
| Before generation (fal echoes only prompt/images) | no | free | free |

## Why

- Sep 20–24: 224 such rejections from one user, about $236 at fal's rate, billed $0. None since Sep 25.
- fal sends no usage header for Grok, so usage comes from the request, as on the success path. The shape matched fal's request log for all 302 rejections: charged jobs ran 10–120 s or more; free ones ended in under 10 s.

## How

- New `UpstreamError.billedUsage`. The fal handler sets it; `trackResponse` bills a failed response only when it is set.
- Only on `x-ai/grok-imagine-video`, where the evidence is. Other fal video models are unchanged.

## Tests

- fal handler: charged vs free rejection shapes.
- Tracking: a failed request carrying billed usage emits one billed event and debits the wallet once.
- The image error rewrap keeps `billedUsage`.

Follow-up to #15458.

gist.headline: No more phantom video tabs
gist.blurb: Grok video requests now keep an honest tab when a video was generated upstream but rejected before delivery. Early rejections still drift away free, as they should.
gist.summary: Fixed Grok Imagine Video billing so failed `x-ai/grok-imagine-video` requests are charged only when xAI/fal generated the video and returned billable usage; rejections before generation remain free.
gist.impact: Callers now receive an explicit charged-error message for post-generation Grok video rejections, while fast pre-generation rejections continue to debit no Pollen.
